title: SoftBank buys DigitalBridge for ~$4B

sources.quote: SoftBank Group Corp. (“SBG”) today announced that on September 30, 2026 (U.S. time), it completed the acquisition of all the outstanding common stock of DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (“DigitalBridge”), a leading global alternative asset manager dedicated to investing in digital infrastructure for approximately USD 3.1 billion.
Transaction Details Under the terms of the agreement, SoftBank Group will indirectly acquire all the outstanding common stock of DigitalBridge for $16.00 per share in cash.

explain: SoftBank bought DigitalBridge, a firm that invests in data centers, towers and fiber, for $16 a share in cash, about $3.1 billion for the shares when the deal closed in September 2026. Including DigitalBridge's debt, the deal was valued at about $4.0 billion when announced.
